query:
UPDATE kanban_tasks SET status = $1,
                position = CASE WHEN status <> $2 THEN
                    (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(position), -1) + 1 FROM kanban_tasks WHERE status = $3)
                    ELSE position END,
                thread_status = NULLIF($4, '')::text,
                workflow_state = CAST($5 AS jsonb)
         WHERE id = $6
